areas.name: Klingzut Mountain - CLOSED AREA
areas.notes:
Klingzut Mountain - Motor Vehicle Closed Area
Motor Vehicle Prohibition Regulation (B.C. Reg. 18/2024), Sch.1 s.115. Map 1-115/23.
Closed YEAR-ROUND to motor vehicles.
Exemption: ATVs/e-bikes allowed only within 400 m of the midline of the road highlighted PURPLE on the official map. Trucks: no vehicle access - foot access beyond that corridor.
MU 7-42. Effective 2024-03-01.

areas.name: Muskwa-Kechika Access Management Area - CLOSED AREA
areas.notes:
Muskwa-Kechika AMA - Motor Vehicle Closed Area
Motor Vehicle Prohibition Regulation (B.C. Reg. 18/2024), Sch.1 s.114. Map 1-114/26 (current).
Closed YEAR-ROUND to motor vehicles, EXCEPT designated road corridors:
• motor vehicle within 10 m of midline of ORANGE roads
• motor vehicle within 400 m of midline of RED roads
• ATV(<750kg)/e-bike within 10 m of GREEN roads/trails
• snowmobile(<500kg) Nov 1 - Apr 15
• plus certain specified parcels.
Corridor widths/road colours are defined on the official map - confirm there.
Covers parts of MUs 7-36, 7-42, 7-43, 7-50 to 7-52, 7-54, 7-57. Updated 2026-06-16.

areas.name: Elk LEH 7-42A (huntable area)
areas.notes:
Elk LEH Zone A of 7-42 (code E_7-42A)

Always confirm against the current Region 7B Peace synopsis before hunting.
